title: Rift Runner
tagline: A mobile-first lane-dodging game that installs to your home screen and plays offline.
stateNote: Built on a starter: the README says it ships with a small playable loop and invites swapping in your own game.
problem: A small, polished mobile loop: a ship runs up a three-lane track and you dodge falling rifts.
audience: Anyone with a phone and a minute, and developers who want a PixiJS and TypeScript starter.
contribution: It is my project, built with Vite, TypeScript, PixiJS v8, GSAP and Howler.js, and set up as an offline PWA.
worksToday: Tap, swipe or use the keyboard to change lanes.
Installs to a phone's home screen as a PWA, per the README.
limitations: It is a starter loop, not a full game.
I checked that the title screen loads.
